data.name: Sharvasya
data.gender_notes: Sharvasya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sarasvat', which refers to the goddess Saraswati. 'Saraswat' means 'abode of Saraswati'. Saraswati is the goddess of knowledge, learning, music, and wisdom. The name Sharvasya carries the meaning “Goddess Saraswati's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvasya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess saraswati's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
